# netbird_agent_network_provider (Data Source)

Read an Agent Network provider by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbird_agent_network_provider" "openai" {
  name = "OpenAI Production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Provider ID
- `name` (String) Display name shown in the dashboard

### Read-Only

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) Not returned by the API (sealed at rest)
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the provider is enabled
- `extra_values` (Map of String) Catalog-specific extra header values
- `identity_header_groups` (String) Wire header for caller groups
- `identity_header_user_id` (String) Wire header for caller display identity
- `metadata_disabled` (Boolean) Whether identity-metadata injection is suppressed for this provider
- `models` (Attributes List) Models exposed through this endpoint (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--models))
- `provider_id` (String) Catalog identifier for the upstream AI provider
- `skip_tls_verification` (Boolean) Whether upstream TLS verification is skipped
- `upstream_url` (String) Full upstream URL that NetBird forwards traffic to

<a id="nestedatt--models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `models`

Read-Only:

- `cache_creation_per_1k` (Number) Anthropic-shape cache rate — cost per 1k cache-creation tokens (additive to input tokens), in USD. Omitted means inherit NetBird's default rate for this model when one exists; 0 means cache writes bill at input_per_1k.
- `cache_read_per_1k` (Number) Anthropic-shape cache rate — cost per 1k cache-read tokens (additive to input tokens), in USD. Omitted means inherit NetBird's default rate for this model when one exists; 0 means cache reads bill at input_per_1k.
- `cached_input_per_1k` (Number) OpenAI-shape cache rate — cost per 1k cached prompt tokens (a subset of input tokens), in USD. Omitted means inherit NetBird's default rate for this model when one exists; 0 means no discount (cached tokens bill at input_per_1k).
- `id` (String) Model identifier
- `input_per_1k` (Number) Cost per 1k input tokens in USD
- `output_per_1k` (Number) Cost per 1k output tokens in USD
